resolution.note: doctor --unattended fails exit 1 naming skills with allowed-tools/hooks lacking Skill(name); tests pass, live repo has none missing

title: Unattended doctor checks skill permission entries for CC 2.1.325
body:
Source: .krn/runs/research/advisor-and-model-features-2026-11-16.md: Claude Code 2.1.325 (2026-11-13) makes scheduled tasks and /loop prompt before running a skill that declares allowed-tools or hooks unless `Skill(name)` is in permissions.allow; an unattended prompt stalls a lane forever.
Outcome: `krn doctor --unattended` lists every repository skill with allowed-tools or hooks that lacks a `Skill(name)` allow entry and exits 1 when one is missing; the repository's .claude/settings.json carries the entries so the check exits 0.
Why: the overnight goal requires runs that never wait for the operator.
Proof: a doctor test with a skill declaring allowed-tools and no allow entry exits 1; the live repo exits 0.
Files: src/cli/doctor.ts, .claude/settings.json, test/cli/doctor.test.ts
